chapters.title: 1. THE PROPHECY: Evil Queen Mortuana receives a prophecy about a peasant rebellion; her raven minion JoJo attends a support group for animals who are cursed royalty. (Featuring Tim Gunn, Meryl Streep, Andrea Martin)
2. BURN THE TOWN: Mo chases laughs on a talk show; JoJo goes on a date with a human Prince. (Featuring Tim Gunn, Peter Dinklage, Andrea Martin, Carol Kane)
3. QUEEN'S DAY: Mo can't take a joke about herself; JoJo performs with her R&B duo. (Featuring Tim Gunn, Audra McDonald, Bob the Drag Queen, Alex Moffat, Chris Redd)
4. RANUNCULUS: Mo attempts to buy a birthday gift for a friend; JoJo seeks the Shard of Acquiescence. (Featuring Tim Gunn, Meryl Streep, Aidy Bryant, Alex Moffat)
5. SHITHEAD: Mo becomes a progressive icon; JoJo finds love with a crow. (Featuring Tim Gunn, Carol Kane, Alex Moffat, Heidi Gardner, Esther Perel)
6. SIRENS: Mo and JoJo look for the Shard in the grotto of the Sirens. (Featuring Tim Gunn, Meryl Streep, Andrea Martin, Alex Moffat, Queer Eye’s Fab Five, Bob the Drag Queen)
7. THE MOLE: Mo suspects Galafhar of treachery; JoJo meets her future in-laws. (Featuring Tim Gunn, Meryl Streep, Audra McDonald)
8. ROAD TRIP: Mo and JoJo butt heads on a journey to the West Coast. (Featuring Meryl Streep, Carol Kane, Alex Moffat, Heidi Gardner)
9. ALUMNI WEEKEND: Mo and JoJo return to Mo's alma mater; a secret is revealed. (Featuring Tim Gunn, Audra McDonald)
10. WHAT A LIFE: Mo deals with the Rebellion; JoJo deals with her hag. (Featuring Tim Gunn, Andrea Martin, Alex Moffat, Heidi Gardner)
